st-jk-gram-panchayats.name: Gram Panchayats of Jammu and Kashmir
st-jk-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Jammu and Kashmir, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-jk-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-jk-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-jk-panchayat-samitis.name: Panchayat Samitis of Jammu and Kashmir
st-jk-panchayat-samitis.description: The intermediate (block) tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Jammu and Kashmir, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-jk-panchayat-samitis.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-jk-panchayat-samitis.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated).

st-jk-zila-parishads.name: Zila Parishads of Jammu and Kashmir
st-jk-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Jammu and Kashmir, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-jk-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-jk-zila-parishads.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated). Typically one Zila Parishad per district, so the count should be close to (but need not exactly equal) the district count.

st-jk-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Jammu and Kashmir
st-jk-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Jammu and Kashmir (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-jk-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-jk-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-jk-assembly.name: Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly
st-jk-assembly.description: Unicameral 90-seat elected assembly (plus up to 5 members nominated by the LG under the 2023 amendment: representation for Kashmiri migrants and displaced persons from Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir). Elected October 2024 after a decade without an assembly government; the Legislative Council was abolished in 2019.
st-jk-assembly.head: st-jk-pos-speaker
st-jk-assembly.notes: Corrected 2026-09-25: Coverage report flagged 'Jammu and Kashmir: 95 MLAs listed for 90 seats'. J&K's assembly has 90 directly elected seats plus up to 5 members the Lieutenant Governor may nominate under the 2023 amendment to the J&K Reorganisation Act 2019 (Woman x2, Kashmiri Migrants x2, PoJK-displaced x1) — data/raw/mlas-jk-ar-mn-ml.json already lists all 95 correctly (90 elected + 5 nominated, all 5 nominated seats vacant as the LG has not made any nominations as of 2026-09-25) with appointmentMode/appointedBy already set correctly. The mismatch was that the entity's own 'seats' field (owned by data/raw/states-dl-jk-la.json, which the build's first-value-wins merge always keeps over later segments' patches) was still 90, undercounting the 5 nominated seats. Setting seats=95 (= total members listed, elected + nominated, per research/india/SCHEMA.md's convention) and adding electedSeats/nominatedSeats to stats for clarity; the existing partyWiseStrength.nominated=5 in states-dl-jk-la.json's stats was already correct and unaffected by this correction. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jammu_and_Kashmir_Legislative_Assembly)
